system.description: When using this High Arcana, ignore Break Gauge penalties to the Spellcraft check. Using a High Arcana doubles the spell's MP cost; only one High Arcana may be used on a spell. Apply any MP cost reductions after doubling.
When using this High Arcana, double the spell's range. Using a High Arcana doubles the spell's MP cost; only one High Arcana may be used on a spell. Apply any MP cost reductions after doubling.

When using this High Arcana, double the spell's targeted area; secondary effects are not enlarged. Using a High Arcana doubles the spell's MP cost; only one High Arcana may be used on a spell. Apply any MP cost reductions after doubling.

When using this High Arcana, double the number of damage dice rolled by the spell. Using a High Arcana doubles the spell's MP cost; only one High Arcana may be used on a spell. Apply any MP cost reductions after doubling.

When using this High Arcana, double a spell's duration when its duration scales. Using a High Arcana doubles the spell's MP cost; only one High Arcana may be used on a spell. Apply any MP cost reductions after doubling.

When using this High Arcana, target a number of additional creatures equal to your Mind modifier (minimum 1). It applies only to spells targeting one creature; area spells may not overlap. Using a High Arcana doubles the spell's MP cost; only one High Arcana may be used on a spell. Apply any MP cost reductions after doubling.
